title: Dielectric cylinder in a uniform field (electrostatics, analytic)
description:
Dielectric cylinder (radius R, eps_cyl) between plates x_lo = V0 and x_hi = 0 (E0 = V0/Lx), insulated y faces.
Analytic: an isolated cylinder has the uniform inside field E_in/E0 = 2/(eps_cyl+1); the plates and insulated faces image it into a square array of area fraction f_area, so the reference is 2/(eps_cyl+1)/(1 - f_area K_pol) (Rayleigh, K_pol = (eps-1)/(eps+1); 0.8 % above the isolated value at eps 100).
Run the sweep (eps_cyl 2, 4, 10, 100). Sweep tab: E_in per value with the analytic curves E_in_vs_eps and E_in_isolated.
Derived values tab: E_in with its relative error (staircase, ~0.1-0.4 %, largest at high contrast) and E_in_y ~ 0.
Line profile tab (last sweep value): E_along_field and E_across_field, field E_x, against E0 (1 + K R^2 (x^2 - y^2)/r^4)/(1 - f K) outside and the uniform value inside.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: voltage of x_lo [V] (x_hi is at 0 V)

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: domain length along the field (electrode gap)

parameters.name: eps_cyl
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of the cylinder (swept; background vacuum)

parameters.name: f_area
parameters.description: area fraction: the Dirichlet x / insulated y faces image the cylinder into a square array

analytic_curves.name: E_along_field
analytic_curves.expression: E0/(1 - f_area*K_pol)*where(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c) < R, 1 - K_pol, 1 + K_pol*R**2*((x - x_c)**2 - (y - y_c)**2)/hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c)**4)

analytic_curves.name: E_across_field
analytic_curves.expression: E0/(1 - f_area*K_pol)*where(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c) < R, 1 - K_pol, 1 + K_pol*R**2*((x - x_c)**2 - (y - y_c)**2)/hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c)**4)
